card.title: TOBRUK
card.text: Tobruk is a city in eastern Libya.

Text.SourceString: Tobruk is a city in eastern Libya.
Text.LocalizedString: Tobruk is a city in eastern Libya.

value.value: You must employ the Italians to keep enemy units occupied while you engage the defenders of Deir el Shein.

SourceString.value: You must employ the Italians to keep enemy units occupied while you engage the defenders of Deir el Shein.

value.value: You have received Italian reinforcements, ready for action.

SourceString.value: You have received Italian reinforcements, ready for action.

value.value: We are sending you self-propelled artillery, it can help deal with the dug-in British defenders.

SourceString.value: We are sending you self-propelled artillery, it can help deal with the dug-in British defenders.

value.value: You’ve got more tanks in reserve, they are at their best harassing the enemy backline.

SourceString.value: You’ve got more tanks in reserve, they are at their best harassing the enemy backline.

value.value: The mobility of your forces can help you avoid the frequent sandstorms in the area.

SourceString.value: The mobility of your forces can help you avoid the frequent sandstorms in the area.

value.value: Remember that few things can withstand a concentrated tank attack.

SourceString.value: Remember that few things can withstand a concentrated tank attack.

value.value: We have arrived at El Alamein. The British have fortified themselves, but the central location of Deir el Shein is still lightly defended.

SourceString.value: We have arrived at El Alamein. The British have fortified themselves, but the central location of Deir el Shein is still lightly defended.

value.value: A sandstorm rages, our operations are impeded. Any unit that moves or attacks is likely to become pinned.

SourceString.value: A sandstorm rages, our operations are impeded. Any unit that moves or attacks is likely to become pinned.

value.value: Deir el Shein is finally in our hands. From it we can strike at enemy forces in any direction.

SourceString.value: Deir el Shein is finally in our hands. From it we can strike at enemy forces in any direction.
